description.value: Ashfall erases most trails within the hour, but you've learned to read what it leaves instead of what it covers. You don't take the normal circumstance penalty to Track a creature through ashfall, heavy dust, or windblown debris.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Track penalty removal is gated on 'ashfall, heavy dust, or windblown debris', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one.
